title: HTB: Voleur
summary: Kerberos-only Active Directory box: enumerate with nxc and rusthound, abuse WriteSPN via bloodyAD to roast a service account, restore a tombstoned user with PowerView, and decrypt DPAPI blobs to reach Domain Admin.

title: HTB: DevHub
summary: An exposed MCPJam Inspector API gives RCE, a leaked Jupyter token pivots to a second user, and a root Flask service leaks the SSH keys for root.

title: HTB: Checkpoint
summary: A windows box that assumes a breach  alex.turner / Checkpoint2024!, which is then used to restore a deleted user called Mark.Davies which had Write access to an SMB Share.

title: HTB: Garfield
summary: This box assumes a breach scenario with credentials j.arbuckle:Th1sD4mnC4t!@1978

title: HTB: Enigma
summary: An NFS share leaks an onboarding PDF with credentials into RoundCube webmail; an OpenSTAManager arbitrary file upload gives a foothold, and OliveTin command injection on an internal service leads to root.
